 Spain Unemployment Rate Back Above 10%
 Less than 1 min read ESUR Spain’s unemployment rate rose to 10.18% in Q3 2026, up from 9.87% in Q2 and above market expectations of 9.9%. 
 The number of unemployed people increased by 95,900, or 3.8%, from the previous quarter, marking the largest rise for a third quarter since Q3 2020. 
 Nevertheless, the unemployment rate was the lowest recorded for a third quarter since 2007. 
 The number of unemployed people reached 2.591 million. 
 Meanwhile, employment increased by 73,600, or 0.3%, marking the weakest gain for a third quarter since 2019. 
 Despite the modest growth, total employment reached a record high of 22.852 million. 
 The number of employed foreign nationals rose by 75,400, or 2%, while employment among Spanish nationals declined by 1,800. 
 By sector, public employment increased by 89,900, while private-sector employment fell by 16,300. 
 The labour force expanded by 169,500 to a record 25.443 million, pushing the participation rate up to 59.5%.
